guesses.reason: Broad bear-like head, small triangular erect ears, deep-set dark eyes, thick double coat, and a plush tail curled over the back are classic American Akita traits, and the black-and-white pinto pattern is an accepted Akita coloring.
The heavy, fluffy coat and sturdy build could hint at some northern spitz influence, though the head shape leans strongly Akita.
The bicolor black-and-white coat and curled tail overlap with husky traits, but the broad muzzle and small eyes favor Akita.

breed.appearance: A large, sturdy spitz-type dog with a broad, bear-like head that is mostly black, with a thin white blaze on the forehead, a white streak along one side of the muzzle, and some gray frosting on the chin and lips that suggests a mature dog. Small, thick, triangular erect ears tip slightly forward over deep-set, almond-shaped brown eyes, and the nose is large and black. The body is a black-and-white pinto with a white chest and legs, large black patches across the back, and a very fluffy cream-white tail curled up over the back.
breed.fun_fact: Akitas are famously loyal, and the legendary Akita Hachiko waited at a Tokyo train station for his owner every day for nearly ten years!
